messages:
sarah_cs: Heads-up — NovusMed flagged as a renewal risk, renewal in ~6 weeks. Saw a sharp drop in activity this week, need a triage.
raj_csm: What metrics? (tokens, calls, errors?)
sarah_cs: Usage summary from our dashboard: gen token volume down 47% week-over-week, embedding calls down ~60%. No billing spike. Their seat usage unchanged. Looks like fewer API requests overall.
emily_pm: Any recent deploys that might affect latency or auth? deploy-bot: deploy completed: inference-runtime v3.12.1 -> 2026-03-16T02:14:01Z (sha: a9f3d2). No rollbacks.
raj_csm: I pulled logs for novusmed-prod: small uptick in 429s mid-week (~0.4% to 1.2%), and a couple of 500s tied to a backpressure event. Could be causing client-side throttling.
sarah_cs: Also got a note from their CSM contact — internal stakeholder change. VP of ML (Mike Chen) left last week; new interim lead Leah Torres is evaluating alternatives.
jordan_sales: Leah Torres — do we know her priorities? cost, latency, control? If she's evaluating competitors we should escalate.
emily_pm: I spoke w/ their PM last month: primary was predictability (tail latency) and model quality. They were running a limited benchmark vs a vendor called OptiServe last quarter.
raj_csm: Ok — likely reasons for usage dip: 1) client disabled non-critical calls while re-evaluating, 2) transient errors/latency causing retries/backoff, 3) stakeholder shift + competitive eval.
sarah_cs: Proposed mitigation: quick root-cause on our side (logs + SLOs), schedule a joint call w/ Leah & their eng lead, offer a 30-day trial of Dedicated capacity at a discounted rate to prove stability, and provide a batch of tailored eval prompts + comparison harness.
jordan_sales: I can offer 30 days free Dedicated trial contingent on a kickoff call this week. Need legal/finance ok — looping in sales ops separately. :+1:
emily_pm: I'll prepare a one-page benchmark summary showing tail latency percentiles, and a small prompt set showing quality parity vs their test cases. Can deliver end of day tomorrow.
raj_csm: I'll run detailed logs: error breakdown, latency p50/p95/p99 for last 7 days, and any config changes on their project. Quick query I used:
```
GET /usage/novusmed/prod?start=2026-03-09&end=2026-03-16
Authorization: Bearer ${REDWOOD_TOKEN}
```
sarah_cs: Also ask support to check if their API key had rate-limit increases or role changes. If they toggled a flag, that could explain drop.
jordan_sales: Reachout plan: I'll ask Leah for a 30-40m call. Offer a joint tech + sales session, include a post-call action plan. If they push price, propose a short-term commitment for a pilot discount.
emily_pm: Add enablement: 1) prompt tuning session, 2) quick troubleshooting doc for 429/500 patterns, 3) eval harness + instructions to run comparisons locally.
raj_csm: Flagging as P1 renewal risk. Owner: raj_csm for technical triage, jordan_sales for commercial outreach, emily_pm for benchmark assets, sarah_cs for overall owner and stakeholder coordination.
sarah_cs: Can we aim to have the call booked within 72 hours and initial logs/benchmarks ready in 48? If yes, I'll send the invite and a short agenda.
jordan_sales: I can do 48-72h. I'll ping Leah now and cc their PM and eng lead. Posting draft invite after I hear availability.
emily_pm: I'll upload the benchmark doc to the shared folder and drop link in thread when ready.
raj_csm: Starting log pull now. Will post findings in thread with a short TL;DR.
sarah_cs: Thanks team. Keep updates concise here. If we get commitment from Leah, let's push the Dedicated trial + canary rollouts to reduce risk. :rocket:
